questions.stem: What is the definition of half-life?

options.text: The time taken for all radioactive atoms to decay
Half the time taken for a radioactive sample to fully decay
The time taken for a radioactive source to become safe
The time taken for half the radioactive nuclei in a sample to decay

questions.explanation: Half-life is the time taken for half the radioactive nuclei in a sample to decay, or equivalently, the time for the activity (count rate) of a sample to fall to half its initial value. It is constant for a given isotope and is not affected by external conditions.
